mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.channel_id, m.user_id, m.content, m.reply_to_id, m.edited, m.created_at, m.updated_at, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, u.status as user_status FROM messages m JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.channel_id = #{channelId} AND m.parent_message_id IS NULL ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id, m.channel_id, m.user_id, m.content, m.reply_to_id, m.edited, m.created_at, m.updated_at, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, u.status as user_status FROM messages m JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.channel_id = #{channelId} AND m.content ILIKE ('%' || #{query} || '%') ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id, m.channel_id, m.user_id, m.content, m.reply_to_id, m.parent_message_id, m.edited, m.created_at, m.updated_at, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, u.status as user_status FROM messages m JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (id, channel_id, user_id, content, reply_to_id, parent_message_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{channelId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{replyToId}, #{parentMessageId})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.channel_id, m.user_id, m.content, m.reply_to_id, m.parent_message_id, m.edited, m.created_at, m.updated_at, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, u.status as user_status FROM messages m JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.parent_message_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND parent_message_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_attachments (id, message_id, file_name, mime_type, file_size, s3_key, url) VALUES (#{id}, #{messageId}, #{fileName}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{s3Key}, #{url})
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, file_name, mime_type, file_size, s3_key, url, created_at FROM message_attachments WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
SELECT id, message_id, file_name, mime_type, file_size, s3_key, url, created_at FROM message_attachments WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_reactions (id, message_id, user_id, emoji) VALUES (#{id}, #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{emoji}) ON CONFLICT (message_id, user_id, emoji) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message_reactions WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND emoji = #{emoji}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_reactions WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND emoji = #{emoji}
